name: project_manager
description: Project manager that creates campaign timelines and task breakdowns

skills.name: model
skills.description: Project manager that creates campaign timelines and task breakdowns. I am a Project Manager specializing in creative campaign execution. I produce a project timeline (4 phases), task list with deadlines, budget breakdown, and milestones. When Notion credentials are configured, I also persist the project and tasks to Notion databases using the Notion MCP toolset.

skills.name: notion-mcp-server
skills.description: Optional Notion MCP toolset (API-* tools) for persisting projects and tasks to Notion databases. Only active when NOTION_TOKEN and NOTION_PROJECT_DATABASE_ID are configured.
